CustomField.description: Names of the skills on this record's Required Skills related list (Required_Skill__c rows), A to Z, comma-separated: the skills CFO Bot always loads together with this one. Filled automatically by Apex (ChatbotInstructionRequiredSkills) whenever a row is added, changed or removed, or a required skill is renamed; nobody can edit it. Blank = no required skills. CFO Bot reads the related list itself, not this field.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The skills that always load with this one, from the Required Skills list below. Updates itself: to change it, add or remove rows in that list.
CustomField.label: Required Skills
